policy.publication: Owner approval for the exact project and version is mandatory
policy.inventory: Never change code, data, environment, settings or processes; transport branches only
policy.purchases: No purchases, subscriptions or budget increases without separate approval
policy.self_changes: Isolated development, tests and rollback; never expand permissions or disable safeguards
policy.parallelism: Start at one worker; measure load before increasing; preserve production resources
policy.notifications: INFO, DECISION, CRITICAL; persisted delivery history; delivery never authorizes an action
policy.chat: Current chat is a source of explicit imports and a return destination, not an automatically readable API

control.approval: Publication, payments, permission changes and business-rule changes require scoped decisions
